*   **Limitations:** Struggles with complex interlacing of entities and artifacts [S2].

The claim states that the model struggles with complex interlacing of entities and artifacts. The evidence in Source [S2] explicitly mentions the NeRFReN model, which uses two types of geometric priors (depth smoothness and bidirectional depth consistency) to separate reflection artifacts from physical entities. The text further states: '但当实体与伪影复杂交叉时则无法区别两者的分离' (However, when entities and artifacts are complexly interlaced, it cannot distinguish their separation). This directly supports the claim.
